title: Ethiopian Spiced Bulgur
community: Ethiopia — bulgur dressed with Ethiopian spices
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Spiced Bulgur — bulgur wheat cooked with onions, turmeric, and a touch of berbere, dressed with kibbeh. The Ethiopian spice treatment applied to bulgur produces something considerably more complex than plain boiled bulgur.
longDesc: Burbur is Ethiopia's version of spiced bulgur — the grain cooked with onion and turmeric and finished with kibbeh. Simple and quick, it is the everyday grain dish that stretches the teff budget while still feeling unmistakably Ethiopian.
steps: Heat oil. Cook onion until golden.
Add turmeric and berbere. Stir 30 seconds.
Add bulgur and water. Bring to a boil.
Cover. Simmer 15—18 minutes until all water is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork. Add kibbeh and mix through.
chefTips: Bloom the spices in oil before adding the bulgur — distributes flavour throughout.
cookingScience: See ETH011 for grain cooking science.
sustainabilityTips: Bulgur is pre-cooked and dried — very energy-efficient to cook (short cooking time).
culturalNote: Burbur reflects Ethiopia's practical cooking wisdom — taking a widely available grain and elevating it with the essential Ethiopian spice tradition into something that feels entirely native.
